translations.web: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land
translations.bsb: “What is it?” I asked. And he replied, “A measuring basket is going forth.” Then he continued, “This is their iniquity in all the land.”
translations.kjv: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
translations.asv: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is the ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their appearance in all the land;
